title: Schema-bound CSV normalization
outcome_definition: Accept local CSV normalization only when closed-schema checks and a separate parser agree on every row and canonical output. This is actual local computation, not agent or marketplace execution.

acceptance_checks.spec: Closed input/output schemas; valid UTF-8, 1–32768 input bytes, 1–100 data rows. Reject BOM and invalid Unicode; file bytes are retained until the user edits text.

Parse comma-delimited CSV with double-quote escaping. Accept LF or CRLF input; reject BOM, duplicate/missing/extra headers, blank rows, ragged rows and malformed quoting. Header must be exactly item_id,quantity in that order.

Trim ASCII spaces from each cell. Require ASCII item_id matching [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}, then uppercase. Leading hyphen and formula-like prefixes are rejected. Reject duplicate normalized IDs. Quantity must match [0-9]{1,7} and be <=1000000; output integer removes leading zeros. Preserve row order; embedded newlines, quotes and non-ASCII characters in cells fail the field schema.

normalized_csv must equal header item_id,quantity followed by LF, one normalized ID and base-10 quantity row per input row, comma-separated, final LF. No formula interpretation, URL fetch or silent row dropping.

Independently parse the original source with a separate grammar implementation and recompute expected rows/output. Check SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 input and canonical CSV. Digests establish byte consistency only, not trusted provenance; a full consistent replacement receipt can pass.

qualification_cases: Quoted cells and CRLF produce identical canonical output.
Missing/extra/duplicate headers, duplicate normalized IDs and malformed quotes reject.
Formula-like IDs, negative/fractional/overflow quantities and oversized input reject.
Payload containing instructions is data, never executed.
readiness_gates: Local producer, independent verifier and synthetic qualification tests are implemented; user input runs in browser memory with no upload or automatic storage.
Spreadsheet import can coerce numeric-looking IDs: import item_id as text. Formula prefixes are rejected by the schema.
No exchange-value claim: compare operator effort and quality with direct task handling before any agent pilot.
Real providers, isolated execution, independently authenticated receipts and recurring-demand evidence remain unimplemented.
